column1: # Forge 1.12 ore dictionary names and what replaced each one, per tag family.
#   FORGE       for hosts that read Forge's own tags (forge:...)
#   CONVENTION  for hosts that read the common convention tags (c:...)
# Each value is a #tag, a single vanilla item id where the family has no tag for the name, or -
# when nothing replaces it and the ingredient is left as shipped.
# Every tag and item here is one the host ships itself, so a recipe naming it never needs a guard:
#   #c:         present in every one of the NeoForge 21.1, 21.11 and 26.3, Fabric API 1.21.11
#   #minecraft: and items present in every vanilla client from 1.13 through 26.3
# The names are the ones Forge 1.12.2's OreDictionary registered for vanilla items, plus copper and
# cropBeetroot, which follow the same naming and name tags every loader ships. A name not listed
# here that starts with ore, ingot, nugget, gem, dust, block, plate or gear is mapped by its
# material instead, and those tags are guarded because only other mods fill them.
